description: This Java source file contains integration tests (ExistsIT class) for verifying the existence of certain features, attributes, and properties in a persistence layer related to 'things' in a system using the Eclipse Ditto framework. It tests criteria-based queries against a database to ensure correct behavior of 'exists' conditions.

classes.name: ExistsIT
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying 'exists' criteria queries on 'things' in persistence layer using Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: createTestData
methods.description: Prepares test data by inserting 'thing' objects into the database before each test.

methods.name: existsByKnownFeatureId
methods.description: Tests existence of things by known feature ID.

methods.name: existsByKnownFeatureIdAndProperty
methods.description: Tests existence of things by feature ID and property.

methods.name: existsByExactAttribute
methods.description: Tests existence of things with an exact attribute key.

methods.name: existsByKnownAttribute
methods.description: Tests existence of things with a known attribute prefix.

methods.name: existsByUnknownAttribute
methods.description: Tests behavior when querying for an unknown attribute, expecting no results.

methods.name: nullAndEmptyValuesExist
methods.description: Verifies that things with null or empty attribute values are correctly identified.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Creates and inserts sample 'thing' objects with attributes and features into the database.
